messages:
maria: Two Expo customers opened issues today: 1) EAS build fails resolving 'stream/web' from our ESM bundle, 2) TS users see a 'Buffer' type missing error. Both block onboarding.

kevin: That's probably the ESM bundle pulling in web-streams polyfills and dev deps. Metro doesn't like 'stream/web' path. Which entry are they getting? import vs "react-native" field?

sam: They reported installing via `yarn add @redwood/inference` and Metro resolved the main/module fields to our esm bundle. We currently don't have a "react-native" exports target, so metro picks esm.

maria: Also one user on Hermes hit a runtime crash: "TypeError: Can't clone stream body" when SDK retries a request after a 401. It looks like our internal retry clones the Request/Body which isn't cloneable in RN fetch impl.

lee: Oof. That's the auth retry behavior bug we talked about. In node/browser fetch you can clone body streams; RN fetch (okhttp/jsc) doesn't support that. We should avoid cloning request bodies in retry path and instead buffer small bodies or require idempotent safe retries.

kevin: Proposed quick fixes:
- Add "react-native" export to package.json pointing to dist/rn/index.js so metro picks RN-safe build.
- Build dist/rn that avoids importing 'stream/web', uses globalThis.crypto shim check, and doesn't rely on ReadableStream cloning.
- Update retry middleware to re-create body from cached ArrayBuffer for non-stream bodies, and fail-fast for stream bodies with clear error telling users to pass a string/json.

maria: For types: current types reference NodeJS.Buffer and stream.Readable which brings in @types/node and breaks TS projects targeting react-native. We should produce an ambient-dts for the RN export (dist/rn/index.d.ts) that uses Uint8Array instead of Buffer and DOM ReadableStream types where present. Also add "types" subpath exports mapping.

sam: Example package.json exports snippet:
```
"exports": {
  ".": {
    "import": "./dist/esm/index.mjs",
    "require": "./dist/cjs/index.cjs",
    "react-native": "./dist/rn/index.js"
  },
  "./package.json": "./package.json"
}
```
And add "types": { ".": "./dist/esm/index.d.ts", "react-native": "./dist/rn/index.d.ts" } (or use a separate types package).

lee: For the retry/cloning issue here's a tiny patch sketch for middleware logic:
```
// pseudo
if (isStreamBody(req.body)) {
  return Promise.reject(new Error('[redwood-sdk] Non-cloneable body: use string/JSON or disable auto-retry'));
}
const saved = await bufferBody(req.body);
// on retry recreate from saved
```
That avoids throwing in RN instead of crashing.

maria: Can we also include a runtime diagnostic helper that warns about non-cloneable bodies and missing globals? e.g. detectRuntime() that logs: 
```
[redwood-sdk] runtime: hermes=true crypto=false ReadableStream=false cloneableBody=false
```
and link to docs. That would reduce support tickets.

kevin: Agree. For onboarding we should publish an examples/expo-minimal that uses expo-managed workflow and shows exact deps to install: `expo`, `react-native-get-random-values` (or expo-random), and a one-file snippet to set globalThis.crypto + polyfill fetch body notes.

sam: Also mention EAS/EAS-build config: ensure metro config blacklist/resolveExtraNodeModules doesn't accidentally resolve node polyfills. Add a troubleshooting FAQ in README with common fixes.

lee: CI task: add a lightweight Metro bundling smoke test that resolves the rn entry and runs terser to ensure no Node built-ins required. I can add a GH action that runs metro-resolver on dist/rn.

ci-bot: Created ticket DEVEX-5178: "Expo/EAS: RN export, retry/body fix, types, example app" assigned to sam, kevin, lee, ETA 6 days.

maria: Great. Sam + Kevin please coordinate on which APIs we accept for retry (signal, body types) and add clear errors for unsupported cases. I'll draft the README troubleshooting + example.

kevin: Will do. I'll open a small PR for the exports + types mapping first.

sam: I'll take the retry/body change and add unit tests that simulate RN fetch clone failure.

maria: Thanks all — high priority for DX. Let's keep messages in the PR about backwards compatibility. :pray:
